texts.preamble: Mbk Traders vs The Food Safety And Standards Authority ... on 16 July, 2025 Author: Manish Pitale Bench: Manish Pitale (1) 932 wp 8575.25 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay Bench At Aurangabad 932 Writ Petition No. 8575 Of 2025 Mbk Traders Versus The Food Safety And Standards Authority Of India And 933 Writ Petition No. 8578 Of 2025 M N Traders Versus The Food Safety And Standards Authority Of India And 934 Writ Petition No. 8581 Of 2025 Tbz Traders Versus The Food Safety And Standards Authority Of India ..... Advocate for the Petitioner/s : Mr. Bharat Raichandani (through Vc) Standing Counsel for Uoi : Mr. R.B. Bhosle Agp for Respondent / State : Mr. V.M. Kagne ..... Coram : Manish Pitale & Y.G. Khobragade, Jj. Date : 16th July, 2025 P.C. :- 1. In these petitions, the grievance of the Petitioners is that areca nuts, which according to the Petitioners are non-edible, were seized on (2) 932 wp 8575.25 28.04.2025 and 01.05.2025.
texts.facts: In these petitions, the grievance of the Petitioners is that areca nuts, which according to the Petitioners are non-edible, were seized on (2) 932 wp 8575.25 28.04.2025 and 01.05.2025. Huge quantity of the said material was seized. 3. Reliance is placed on Section 42(2) of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, to contend that upon analysis of samples of such material a report was to be generated within 14 days to be sent to the Designated Officer with a copy to the Commissioner of Food Safety. Thereupon, further action could be taken under the said provision. 4. It is the specific case of the Petitioners that after seizure of the aforesaid goods, as far back on 28.04.2025 the Petitioners had moved representations before the concerned Authorities for release of their seized goods, inter alia on the ground that the same are perishable. It is stated that there is neither any response to the said representations nor is copy of any report furnished to the Petitioners. During the course of hearing of these three Writ Petitions, we find that number of questions arise with regard to 1 of 3 (( 2 )) 924-WP-8575-2025++ compliance with Section 42 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006. The primary concern of the Mbk Traders vs The Food Safety And Standards Authority ... on 7 August, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/36549153/ 1 Petitioners in the present Petitions, for the present, appears to be release of the subject goods i.e. areca nuts, which the Petitioners claim to be non edible in nature. The Petitioners are also concerned about release of the vehicles in which the material was being transported.
